verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager, so supply-chain protections against malicious packages are a fair axis. However, the evidence documents no switchable protection such as blocking install/lifecycle scripts or enforcing a minimum release age. Hermetic builds that see only declared dependencies (nix-docs-59) and hash-verifiable reproducibility (nix-comm-19) are adjacent properties, not the requested controls, so they earn no credit.
